title: Complex IF...ELSE Statement

lines.code: #Let user enter the number between 1 and 20, check if the number is valid, then check if the nunber is even or odd and give the square of the number as output to user
enter_number = int(input("Please enter a number between 1 and 20: "))
lines.explanation: This statement takes an input from the users. int() is added to ensure that the input is treated as a integer, not a string
This conditional statement ensures the input is more than or equal to '1'
If the above condition is true, it will check for 2nd condition. This conditional statement ensures the input is less than or equal to '20'

lines.code: print("You have entered a valid number")
lines.explanation: If the above 2 conditions are true, the user is notified that the entered number is valid
3rd condition checks if the number is even. This is done by checking if the remainder is '0' when the number is divided by 2
If the remainder is '0', then the number is even
If the number is divided by '0' and the remainder is '1' then the number is odd
If the number is not less than or equal to 20, the code will jump to this 'else' statement
User will be notified that the entered number is not valid
If the number is not more than or equal to 1, the code will jump to this 'else' statement
User will be notified that the entered number is not valid
